chunks: And in the narration of Jamil, that he said:
"The ghusl of your day suffices for your night, and the ghusl of your night suffices for your day."

key_terms.جَمِيلٍ: Jamil, the narrator named in the report
key_terms.لَيْلَتِكَ: your night, referring to the nighttime period
key_terms.يَوْمِكَ: your day, referring to the daytime period
key_terms.يُجْزِيكَ: is sufficient for you, fulfills the requirement

ai.seo_question: Does the ghusl performed in the day suffice for the night, and does the ghusl of the night suffice for the day?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about ghusl in relation to the day and night, indicating that a ghusl performed in one covers the adjoining period as well. It reflects ease in ritual preparation within the rulings related to worship and hajj.
